# P15 progress — bounded reference/provenance repair

Review scope: bounded_partial_work. The prior complete-audit claim is retracted. The 53-row matrix exceeded the approved eight-assessment review slice and remains provisional. Product implementation is disabled and human acceptance pending.

Skeptical audit: pass for this bounded repair. Actual source bytes and retained reviews are the baseline; structural checks cannot establish semantic validity or choose an architecture. The registered checker does not resolve anchors; the saved v2 validator supplies the recursive diagnostic. No scientific experiment or product work.

Saved: byte-identical before-snapshots and current master checkpoint; v2 eight-assessment JSON/companion with recovered execution-1 provenance; repair JSON/analysis recording all review findings, claim-specific replacements, changed edges and deferred clauses. MC22/23/28–33/35, G8 and top-level assessment locators are repaired. Coverage's live checkpoint dependencies were replaced and completion reporting corrected. All original v1 evidence is preserved. The task-local completion record records these baselines and the two missing v2 reports.

Changed files so far: P15 coverage.json/result.md/progress.md; evidence-v2 snapshots/manifest; p15-evidence-assessments-v2.json/.md; p15-reference-repair-v2.json/.md; the saved diagnostic and registered-check captures; and p15-reference-completion-v1.json. The checker capture is structural evidence only.

Current task: generate p15-assessment-validation-v2.json and p15-reference-validation-v2.json with the saved validator, then independently verify their passed/errors fields, recursive hashes and links, catalog/page counts, replacement support and preserved historical bytes. Capture any fresh checker/process metadata in versioned proposal files; never run the v1 validator or overwrite retained evidence.
